title: Read the night at a glance
summary: A clearer clinical journal puts your assignment first, then the live staffing picture and team detail.
changes: The Night screen leads with a distinct assignment panel and a concise staffing brief instead of statistic tiles.
The full roster reads as a searchable ledger, with clearer role and exception details.
Navigation, Changes, Breaks, Chat, account and first-use surfaces share a quieter visual rhythm, with clinical content kept solid.
